name: The Skylette Mage
source:
n the cold of a long winter Skylette trudges up the slopes of Aetherpeak during a heavy snowfall near her former home village, Mistyhollow.

However, the journey to her destination also stirs up long-repressed memories of her days living in the Church's orphanage and her childhood friend, Blair—along with a particular nun named Sister Aryiah who she always thought of as family. Plus, she sees vague glimpses of the nearby sunflower-covered meadows that glows so bright it catches the sunlight, but in winter all that remains are desolate fields.

Eventually when Skylette finally reaches a certain point up the mountain… it's there, she finds a glowing oval object that quickly attracts her attention. But she also runs into two very different strangers… one who is a fiery-spirited thief, and the other who is an ice phoenix.

What awaits Skylette in this dreary little village of Mistyhollow which is tucked beneath the mountains?

Of course, there is also signs of something dark and sinister brewing somewhere… that may turn into a huge storm, perhaps… but not everyone can survive its wrath.

And regrettably… Skylette gets stuck in the crossfires of the situation. But she's still desperately wishing to ignore it all—to avoid the cold future rushing towards her—since Skylette is always dreaming of open and free skies. 

[From [url=https://citruskoi.itch.io/the-skylette-mage]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在寒冷的漫长冬季里，斯凯莱特在她以前的家乡迷雾谷附近下了一场大雪，艰难地爬上以太峰的山坡。

然而，前往目的地的旅程也唤起了她在教会孤儿院生活的日子和她儿时的朋友布莱尔以及她一直认为是家人的名叫阿莉亚修女的特殊修女的长期压抑记忆。此外，她还能隐约看到附近长满向日葵的草地，它们在阳光下闪闪发光，但在冬天，只剩下荒凉的田野。

最终，当斯凯莱特最终到达山上的某个地点时……就在那里，她发现了一个发光的椭圆形物体，很快吸引了她的注意力。但她也遇到了两个截然不同的陌生人……一个是火热盗贼，另一个是冰凤凰。

在这个隐藏在山下的迷雾谷沉闷的小村庄里，斯凯莱特正在等待着什么呢？

当然，也有迹象表明某些黑暗和险恶的事物正在某处酝酿……这可能会变成一场巨大的风暴，也许……但并不是每个人都能在它的愤怒中幸存下来。

遗憾的是……斯凯莱特陷入了困境。但她仍然迫切希望忽略这一切，以避免寒冷的未来向她袭来，因为斯凯莱特总是梦想着开放和自由的天空。

[来自[url=https://citruskoi.itch.io/the-skylette-mage]itch.io[/url]]
